History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient reports no shortness of breath or chest pain.
Patient is feeling tired, weak, and has muscle pain (myalgia).
Patient feels shivery, hot and cold, and may have a fever.
Patient denies any nausea or vomiting, and appetite is maintained.
There was an initial episode of diarrhea which has now resolved.
Patient denies any urinary symptoms or rashes.

Past_Medical_History.content: Patient has a history of Type 2 diabetes and hypertension (HTN).

Adverse_Drug_Reactions_and_Allergies.content: Patient has no known drug allergies.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient lives with a partner, works in IT, and denies stress.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient is an ex-smoker, having quit 6 months ago.
Patient drinks less than 9 units of alcohol per week.

Assessment.content: The impression is a viral upper respiratory tract infection (URTI).

Plan_of_Care.content: Advised supportive management including bed rest, increased fluid intake, and regular paracetamol.

Follow_up_Information.content: Patient to have a review in 5-7 days if not better.
